about: One entry per headline claim. tests/test_claims.py recomputes each named value from its committed source file and fails on any drift. Each `quotes` entry binds the claim to its published text: `text` is filled with the rendered values ({name}, {label}) and must appear verbatim in `file`; a demo data quote (`path` + `value`) must equal the source value exactly, numbers in type and value. scripts/check_claims.py also scans README.md, docs/JUDGING.md, docs/SUBMISSION.md and the demo page for stale wording. Only claims whose source is on integration are listed; add new results as new entries when they merge.

rules.fixed:N: format the number with N decimals
rules.pct:N: multiply by 100 and format with N decimals
rules.comma[:N]: thousands separators, with N decimals if given (1,000; 2,149.61)
rules.word: the first word of a string label
rules.eq: the value as stored (strings, integers, booleans)
rules.ratio: first path divided by second path, then the rule
rules.product: first path times second path, then the rule
rules.md: the string with | escaped as \\| (inside a Markdown table cell)
rules.median_ratio: {over, items, group, num, den, pick}: for each group of `over` (by `group`), the median over its `items` of num/den; then the min or max of those medians, then the rule
rules.distinct: [list path, key]: the number of distinct values of key across the list
rules.len: the length of the list at the path
rules.spct:N: like pct:N with an explicit sign (+0.2, -0.7)
rules.re:PATTERN: the first group of PATTERN found in the string
